messages:
alex_cs: Quick draft of a tiny customer-facing ops sprint for onboarding (caching, batching, streaming). Want this super runnable. PTAL.

alex_cs: Sprint goal: achieve stable livemode with p95 <350ms and predictable token cost within 48-72h.

alex_cs: Copy-paste checklist for customers:
1) Turn on prefix KV cache for repeated prompts (default TTL=300s).
2) Start with conservative batching: max_wait_ms=20, max_batch_size=12.
3) Enable streaming for interactive UX; keep chunk_size=256.
4) Run warmup: 2x steady RPS for 60s across primary routes.
5) Confirm Console metrics: route.latency.p95, route.cache.hit_rate, route.batch.size_avg, route.error.rate.

kevin_eng: Add telemetry keys: route.kv.prefetch_rate and route.kv.evictions. Also suggest quantization note: use Q4 for low-latency paths; document quality tradeoffs separately.

alex_cs: Pasteable config snippet for customers:
```yaml
route: /v1/chat
model: chat-xl
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 300
batching:
  latency_slo_ms: 350
  max_wait_ms: 20
  max_batch_size: 12
streaming:
  enabled: true
  chunk_size: 256
```

kevin_eng: Tiny Node streaming example to include:
```js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({model:'chat-xl',stream:true,prompt:'hi'})});
const reader = res.body.getReader();
while(true){const {done,value}=await reader.read(); if(done) break; process.stdout.write(new TextDecoder().decode(value));}
```

alex_cs: Warmup one-liner for customers (bash):
for i in {1..60}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"chat-xl","prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":8}'; sleep 0.5; done

alex_cs: Quick validation to paste back to CS:
- Health: curl -s https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- Warmup result: share p95 from the tool you used (wrk/ab)
- Console checks: cache.hit_rate > 15% after warmup, batch.size_avg > 3 for background jobs

alex_cs: Rollback knobs for customers:
- Latency spike -> set max_wait_ms: 0 (disable batching)
- Incorrect cached outputs -> prefix_kv: false
- Cost spike -> route to model_alias: fallback-small via Console routing

tanya_csm: Renewal-risk triggers to watch first week: tokens < 30% expected, repeated manual rollbacks, error.rate > 5%. If any hit, AE outreach. Add a short post-24h survey: 1) Responsiveness 1-5, 2) Output degradation Y/N, 3) Changes made?

maya_acme: Thanks team, helpful. Two quick Qs: is 300s TTL okay for session prompts? and should warmup hit multiple routes?

alex_cs: Answer: 300s usually OK for session prompts; drop to 60-120s if metadata changes frequently. Warmup: hit the most common user-facing routes (login/search/chat) to populate multiple caches.

sre-bot: deploy:tiny-onboard-play v1.0 saved to customer-success/playbooks by kevin_eng at 2012345685 :white_check_mark:
